title: Mailflare before 48957fb Host Header Injection in Password Reset
desc: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. title: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 Orphaned SMF Sessions via Create SM Context Response
desc: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a missing resource release vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to orphan SMF sessions by triggering Create SM Context response processing failures. Attackers can repeatedly release the RAN UE context while responses are pending, causing AMF_SESS_CLEAR() without Release SM Context requests and degrading SMF availability.

title: OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 Memory Leak via SM Policy Deletion
desc: OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in pcf_smpc::delete_sm_policy_handler() that leaves stale UE IPv4, SUPI and DNN index entries after association deletion. Attackers can trigger repeated SM policy create and delete cycles over N7 via PDU session establishment and release to grow PCF memory without bound and break association lookups.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion via xmt_parse_command
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that casts target nodes to GF_ParentNode without validation. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT-A file whose command targets a non-grouping node, causing gf_node_list_get_child() to perform an invalid memory read and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Double Free via gf_sg_sfcommand_del
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that leaves a stale GF_Command pointer in a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer when the buffer element is not properly closed. title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_sg_command_new via XMT Loader
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via MPEG-4 Sensor Handling
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that makes compositor_mpeg4_get_sensor_handler_ex() call hs->IsEnabled through a near-NULL pointer, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via xmt_text_content
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in XMT Loader
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Heap Buffer Over-read in gf_xml_sax_peek_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via Discarded XMT Nodes
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf_node_unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Uncontrolled Recursion via xmt_discard_subtree
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via Stale URL Segment Pointer
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

title: Servas before 1.2.0 Missing Authorization in Tag, Link, and Group Controllers
desc: Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via Discarded Out-of-Scope Node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

title: freedit before 0.9.9 Authorization Bypass in Post Editing via Private Inn
desc: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the edit_post_post handler for POST /post/edit/:pid that skips ownership and status checks when a Private inn is submitted. Members of a Private inn can overwrite any post by sequential id, including moderator-locked posts, re-attributing it to themselves and destroying original content.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in TraverseForm
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Uncontrolled Recursion via gf_sg_proto_instantiate
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free via gf_sg_proto_del
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node_code lists is freed by gf_sg_reset(), and gf_sg_proto_del() then calls gf_node_unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in xmt_resolve_od_links via SFNode Replacement
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion in gf_sg_command_apply MFNode Field Replace
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in gf_sg_command_apply via MFNode Field Replace Without Value
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via JSScript_LoadVRML
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in Compositor Node Handlers
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_event_target_get_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 NULL Pointer Dereference in gf_sg_proto_create_node
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Out-of-Bounds Read in avilib via AVI Audio Tracks
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_sg_proto_del via XMT PROTO Delete
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion in ctxload_process via XMT ODUpdate
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Heap Buffer Over-read via Text fontStyle Type Confusion
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Use-After-Free in gf_node_unregister via PROTO Nodes
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

title: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 Type Confusion via Curve2D point Field
desc: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

desc: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

desc: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. Attackers can request the front-end login path with a pagename query variable to make WordPress render hidden published pages or the full blog index.

title: Members WordPress Plugin before 3.3.1 Missing Authorization via Latest Comments Block
desc: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.

title: Members WordPress Plugin before 3.3.1 Missing Authorization via Latest Posts Block
desc: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

title: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 CSRF via Show Delete Action
desc: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.

title: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 Denial of Service via Bencode Decoder Recursion
desc: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.

title: anacrolix/torrent before 1.63.0 Improper Certificate Validation via HTTPS Tracker Client
desc: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.

title: libical before 4.0.7 Double Free via icalparser_clean
desc: libical before 4.0.7 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in icalparser_clean() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying truncated iCalendar input. Attackers can provide an iCalendar file or stream missing a matching END line, causing the returned component to be freed twice and crashing applications.

title: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 Use-After-Free via WinPR LinkedList Enumerator
desc: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the WinPR wLinkedList collection because LinkedList_FreeNode() frees nodes without updating the cached list->current enumerator pointer. When calling code removes the node the enumerator references, LinkedList_Enumerator_MoveNext() or LinkedList_Enumerator_Current() reads freed heap memory, which can crash the process.

title: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 XSS via Chunked Upload Race Condition
desc: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users with upload permission to bypass SVG sanitization. Attackers can race concurrent chunked uploads sharing a filename to swap a benign SVG with a script-bearing SVG, executing stored cross-site scripting in the site origin.

title: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 Denial of Service via Parser max_tokens Comment Runs
desc: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the parser max_tokens limit using long runs of comments. Attackers can submit GraphQL documents of consecutive comments that Lexer.lookahead fully tokenizes before limit checks, consuming CPU and memory proportional to document size.

title: Donetick before 0.1.86 Path Traversal via Profile Image Field
desc: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' files by storing a crafted image value via PUT /api/v1/users. Attackers can set their image to a traversal key and upload a new profile photo, causing storage.Delete to remove other users' attachments or photos under the storage root.

title: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 Login CSRF via OIDC Callback
desc: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback handler because OIDC state is not bound to the initiating browser. Attackers can start an OIDC login with their own account and lure victims into opening the withheld callback URL, logging them into the attacker's account to read saved snippets.

title: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 Stale Email Verification Status via PATCH /email
desc: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an improper verification vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retain the emailVerified flag by changing their email address while EMAIL_VERIFICATION is disabled. title: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 ProxyAuth Access Control Bypass via Encoded Path Separators
desc: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

title: Opencast before 20.6 Path Traversal via Workspace File Resolution

title: Gogs before 0.14.4 Path Equivalence Bypass via NTFS .git Aliases
desc: Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

title: diaspora* before 0.10.0 Path Traversal via Account Import Photos Archive
desc: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a path traversal (zip slip) vulnerability in ImportService#unzip_photos_file that allows authenticated users to write files outside the extraction folder. Attackers can upload a crafted photos zip archive during account import with ../ entry names to create new files at arbitrary locations writable by the diaspora* process.

title: diaspora* before 0.10.0 HTML Injection via Inviter Name in Invitation Emails
desc: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in Notifier#invite that allows authenticated users to inject HTML or markdown into invitation emails through unescaped profile names. Attackers can set profile first or last names containing raw HTML, links, or images so invitation emails sent from the pod render spoofed content in recipients' mail clients.

title: msgpackr before 2.1.4 Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity via UnpackrStream and decodeIter
desc: msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

title: Delta Sharing Server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 Incorrect Permission Assignment via Azure SAS Tokens
desc: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.

title: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 HTTP Request Smuggling via ASGI Python Parser
desc: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. title: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 Memory Exhaustion via ASGI HTTP/1 Parser
desc: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

title: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 Improper Signature Verification via HTTP-Redirect Binding
desc: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. desc: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 contains a link following vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to read host files by setting --eventpath in an untrusted project .actrc to a symlink. Attackers can commit an event.json symlink pointing to files like ~/.ssh/id_rsa, which act copies into the job container as GITHUB_EVENT_PATH for workflow steps to exfiltrate.

title: erxes before 3.4.14 Missing Authentication via insurance_api Contract Template Mutations
desc: erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

title: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 Stored XSS via SVG Sanitizer Re-serialization
desc: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sanitize-svg function that allows authenticated users to bypass filtering through unescaped re-serialization. Attackers with file edit permission can upload SVGs using entity-encoded or CDATA-wrapped markup or attribute quote breakouts to execute JavaScript in the Penpot origin when victims open them.

title: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 2FA Bypass via Race Condition in /api/2fa/verify
desc: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

desc: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

desc: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie. Attackers can pass an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and set the domain query to a host they control, causing processItems to send the _jdb_session cookie there.

desc: Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.

desc: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. title: Weblate before 2026.11 Account Takeover via Unicode E-mail Matching in Password Reset
desc: Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

title: HumHub before 1.19.4 Missing Authorization via Admin Group Member Search Actions
desc: HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Out-of-Bounds Read via Collada ReadFloat
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Out-of-Bounds Read via glTF 1.0 Accessor Counts
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Uninitialized Resource Use via glTF 1.0 Strip/Fan Faces
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Uncontrolled Memory Allocation via FBX Rotation Keyframe Interpolation
desc: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.
